name: Butterfly's Breath Trap (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-12: Negotiations for the Star Gun
description: A sickly-sweet perfume wafts through the air outside the council building, assaulting the senses of all that inhale it.
disable: DC 20 Survival check to hold your breath through the perfume, DC 19 Occultism check (trained) to draw a warding rune in the air to disperse the poison, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 17) to counteract the poison

offensiveAbilities.name: Goodnight Kiss
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens the doors of the Segada council building

Effect All creatures within 10 feet are exposed to the butterfly's breath poison.

offensiveAbilities.name: Butterfly's Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 21 Fortitude save

Onset 10 minutes

Stage 1 Stupefied 1 (6 hours)

Stage 2 stupefied 1 (12 hours)

Stage 3 stupefied 1 (24 hours)
